video.title: AI欧腐《暗恋我的死党/Bestfriend Crush: A Gay Romance》
video.desc:
Tristan Faughn has been Roth Dimitri's best friend since childhood, standing by him through every victory, mistake, and heartbreak. Roth sees their bond as unbreakable friendship, but Tristan has hidden a secret: he has loved Roth for years. When another man shows interest in Tristan, Roth faces a jealousy he doesn't understand. As their friendship shifts, both must confront feelings they've long avoided.
Tristan Faughn 从小就是 Roth Dimitri 最好的朋友，陪他走过每一次胜利、每一个错误、每一场心碎。在 Roth 眼里，两人是牢不可破的友情；而 Tristan 却藏着一个秘密：他已经爱了 Roth 很多年。
当另一个男人对 Tristan 表现出兴趣，Roth 感到一阵自己也无法理解的嫉妒。随着友情悄然变质，两人都必须直面那些长久以来刻意回避的感情。
